mechanism: Armodafinil may antagonize the antipsychotic effects of prochlorperazine through dopaminergic stimulation while both agents increase CNS stimulation risk and prochlorperazine is metabolized via CYP3A4/CYP2D6 with potential for modest armodafinil-mediated enzyme induction.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and increased CNS side effects; consider alternative stimulant or adjust prochlorperazine dosing if used concurrently.
